scope: Two fixed externally annotated retrieval subsets with reduced candidate pools; not full BEIR/C-MTEB benchmark results. Unjudged candidates are not asserted to be human-verified negatives.

selectionProtocol.querySelection: First16 distinct query IDs in lexical ascending order from positive test/dev qrels; no model-output selection.
selectionProtocol.documents: All qrels-positive documents for selected queries, plus top2 BM25 corpus candidates per query outside its positive set, plus16 documents ordered by SHA256(dataset name + document ID) outside all selected positives.

bm25.tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric words and individual CJK ideographs; no model embeddings

selectionProtocol.text: English title + newline + text; Chinese original text. Preserve all original content.

inputProfile.queryInstruction: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query

selectionProtocol.scope: Two fixed externally annotated retrieval subsets with reduced candidate pools; not full BEIR/C-MTEB benchmark results. Unjudged candidates are not asserted to be human-verified negatives.
selectionProtocol.copyright: Source text stays in internal evidence. Customer page publishes aggregate results and source links; do not redistribute Chinese corpus without explicit license.

metricDefinition: Macro average across16 queries per language. Positive means original qrels grade>0. NDCG@10 gain=2**grade-1. Document score=max chunk cosine. Unjudged candidate grades treated as0 for this subset, not asserted to be verified negatives.
